shell.purpose: Title bar and band ground; block title strips; inverse button label.

ink.purpose: Body text, titles, section and table-header rules.

primary.purpose: Primary button fill and selected segment.

accent.purpose: Progress and the current item only.

success.purpose: Correct progress segments and success tints.

successInk.purpose: Success text and success block titles.

error.purpose: Wrong segments, error tints, invalid borders.

errorInk.purpose: Error text, danger buttons, error block titles.

dark-shell.purpose: Title bar and band ground; block title strips; inverse button label.

dark-shellInk.purpose: Text on the title bar and bands; active route; band rules and inverse button fill.

dark-sunken.purpose: Block bodies, notices, tags, code, hover fills.

dark-ink.purpose: Body text, titles, section and table-header rules.

dark-inkSoft.purpose: Secondary text: ledes, table headers, facts labels, inactive tabs.

dark-primary.purpose: Primary button fill and selected segment.

dark-onPrimary.purpose: Text and icons on primary fills.

dark-accent.purpose: Progress and the current item only.

dark-accentInk.purpose: Accent as text on the ground.

dark-success.purpose: Correct progress segments and success tints.

dark-successInk.purpose: Success text and success block titles.

dark-error.purpose: Wrong segments, error tints, invalid borders.

dark-errorInk.purpose: Error text, danger buttons, error block titles.

contrast-shell.purpose: Title bar and band ground; block title strips; inverse button label.

contrast-shellInk.purpose: Text on the title bar and bands; active route; band rules and inverse button fill.

contrast-shellMuted.purpose: Idle route links and icons on the title bar; labels and hints on bands.

contrast-surface.purpose: Fields, choice groups and grid cells, menus, dialogs; base for every state tint.

contrast-sunken.purpose: Block bodies, notices, tags, code, hover fills.

contrast-ink.purpose: Body text, titles, section and table-header rules.

contrast-inkSoft.purpose: Secondary text: ledes, table headers, facts labels, inactive tabs.

contrast-primary.purpose: Primary button fill and selected segment.

contrast-onPrimary.purpose: Text and icons on primary fills.

contrast-accent.purpose: Progress and the current item only.

contrast-accentInk.purpose: Accent as text on the ground.

contrast-success.purpose: Correct progress segments and success tints.

contrast-successInk.purpose: Success text and success block titles.

contrast-error.purpose: Wrong segments, error tints, invalid borders.

contrast-errorInk.purpose: Error text, danger buttons, error block titles.

page-title.purpose: One page title per route; 1.5rem, stepping to 1.75rem from 640px. Visually hidden on the Dashboard, where the band opens the page.

question.purpose: The question stem in the study loop; 1.25rem, stepping to 1.5rem from 640px; from 1024px the left of two equal columns.

figure.purpose: Dashboard progress numbers in Fira Sans Light (300): 1.75rem, line-height 1, tabular, -0.01em.

statement.purpose: The next-action sentence in the Dashboard band and the empty-state line, in Fira Sans Light (300); 1.5rem, stepping to 1.75rem from 640px.

wordmark.purpose: The "Lembrion" wordmark in the title bar and the boot bar.

section-title.purpose: Section headings, always over a 2px Deck Ink rule (Title-bar White rule and text on a band).

subhead.purpose: Block titles, option keys, small headings inside a section.

small.purpose: Tables, facts labels, hints, session strip, meta lines.

label.purpose: Field labels, table headers, facts values, small buttons, segments.

note.purpose: Option notes after grading ("Your answer", "Correct answer").

toast-message.purpose: Toast messages, in Soft Slate Ink.

mono.purpose: Code blocks, inline code (0.9em), keys, model IDs, URLs, key hints.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Theme menu, dialogs and toasts only (.menu, .overlay-shadow, .toast).

shadows.name: active-underline
shadows.purpose: Current title-bar link and selected tab; transparent at rest. A line device, not elevation.

shadows.name: field-focus
shadows.purpose: Doubles a focused field border (with border-color: var(--color-focus)).

shadows.name: scrim
shadows.purpose: Background behind dialogs (bg-black/40). A fill, listed here for completeness.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: --ease-out: underline moves and both rule animations.

motion.name: state-colour
motion.purpose: Background, border and text colour changes on buttons, fields, rows, segments, links (CSS ease-out keyword).

motion.name: underline
motion.purpose: Active underline (box-shadow) on title-bar links and tabs.

motion.name: rule-grow
motion.purpose: Each filled progress segment grows from the left once (scaleX 0 to 1).

motion.name: toast-in
motion.purpose: Toast entry: fade in from opacity 0 and translateY(-6px).

motion.name: toast-out
motion.purpose: Toast exit (data-leaving): fade out and rise 6px.

motion.name: rule-travel
motion.purpose: Loading rule and boot rule: a one-third bar travels translateX(-100%) to translateX(300%).

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: prefers-reduced-motion: every animation and transition collapses to 0.01ms; the boot rule stops.

components.css: .ds-inverse-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 1.25rem; background: var(--color-shell, #23373b); } .ds-btn-inverse, .ds-btn-outline-inverse { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0.25rem; font-family: "Fira Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-inverse { background: var(--color-shellInk, #ffffff); border-color: var(--color-shellInk, #ffffff); color: var(--color-shell, #23373b); } .ds-btn-inverse:hover:not(:disabled) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shellInk, #ffffff) 86%, var(--color-shell, #23373b)); } .ds-btn-outline-inverse { background: transparent; border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shellInk, #ffffff) 45%, transparent); color: var(--color-shellInk, #ffffff); } .ds-btn-outline-inverse:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--color-shellInk, #ffffff); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-shellInk, #ffffff) 10%, transparent); } .ds-btn-inverse:disabled, .ds-btn-outline-inverse:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-inverse-row button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #eb811b); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: Label above, hint below; mono for keys, model IDs and URLs; focus doubles the border.

components.name: Choice Grid
components.description: Choice cells tiled in columns with 1px gaps in Control Slate mixed 55% into surface; question type takes 3 columns from 640px.
components.css: .ds-choice-grid { display: grid; gap: 1px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-lineStrong, #869699); border-radius: 0.25rem; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-lineStrong, #869699) 55%, var(--color-surface, #ffffff)); font-family: "Fira Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-choice { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-choice:hover { background: var(--color-sunken, #eef1f1); } .ds-choice:has(input:checked) { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #23373b) 8%, var(--color-surface, #ffffff)); } .ds-choice input { flex-shrink: 0; width: 1rem; height: 1rem; margin: 0.25rem 0 0; accent-color: var(--color-primary, #23373b); } .ds-choice input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #23373b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-choice-text { min-width: 0; } .ds-choice-title { display: block; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink, #23373b); } .ds-choice-desc { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; color: var(--color-inkSoft, #45585c); } @media (min-width: 640px) { .ds-choice-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }

components.css: .ds-options { max-width: 68ch; font-family: "Fira Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; } .ds-option { display: grid; width: 100%; grid-template-columns: 1.75rem 1fr auto; align-items: baseline; column-gap: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line, #dfe5e5); background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #23373b); text-align: left; font-family: "Fira Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms ease-out, color 120ms ease-out; } .ds-option:first-child { border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line, #dfe5e5); } .ds-option:disabled { cursor: default; } .ds-option:not(:disabled):hover { background: var(--color-sunken, #eef1f1); } .ds-option:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #23373b); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-option-key { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-inkSoft, #45585c); } .ds-option-note { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; white-space: nowrap; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-option[data-state='selected'] { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #23373b) 9%, var(--color-surface, #ffffff)); } .ds-option[data-state='selected'] .ds-option-key { color: var(--color-ink, #23373b); } .ds-option[data-state='correct'] { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-success, #14b03d) 12%, var(--color-surface, #ffffff)); } .ds-option[data-state='correct'] .ds-option-key, .ds-option[data-state='correct'] .ds-option-note { color: var(--color-successInk, #0d7a2a); } .ds-option[data-state='wrong'] { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-error, #d13a2e) 10%, var(--color-surface, #ffffff)); } .ds-option[data-state='wrong'] .ds-option-key, .ds-option[data-state='wrong'] .ds-option-note { color: var(--color-errorInk, #b3261e); } .ds-option[data-state='muted'] { color: var(--color-inkMuted, #5b6c70); }

components.name: Progress Rule

components.css: .ds-rules { display: grid; gap: 1.5rem; } .ds-progress-rule { display: flex; gap: 1px; width: 100%; height: 0.25rem; background: var(--color-line, #dfe5e5); } .ds-progress-rule > span { flex: 1; height: 100%; transform-origin: left center; } .ds-progress-rule > [data-state='correct'] { background: var(--color-success, #14b03d); } .ds-progress-rule > [data-state='wrong'] { background: var(--color-error, #d13a2e); } .ds-progress-rule > [data-state='current'] { background: var(--color-accent, #eb811b); } .ds-progress-rule > [data-state='pending'] { background: transparent; } .ds-progress-rule > [data-state]:not([data-state='pending']) { animation: ds-rule-grow 480ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-loading-rule { position: relative; height: 0.25rem; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--color-line, #dfe5e5); } .ds-loading-rule::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 33.333333%; background: var(--color-accent, #eb811b); animation: ds-rule-travel 1.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) infinite; } @keyframes ds-rule-grow { from { transform: scaleX(0); } to { transform: scaleX(1); } } @keyframes ds-rule-travel { from { transform: translateX(-100%); } to { transform: translateX(300%); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-progress-rule > span, .ds-loading-rule::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms; animation-iteration-count: 1; } }

narrative.overview:
Lembrion is set like a well-made Metropolis Beamer deck. One dark teal title bar carries the wordmark and the routes; below it sits a pale ground with one idea per frame, and during a session a 4px progress line under the bar records every answer. Where a page needs an overview, the bar's ground carries on below it as a band, Metropolis's standout frame: the Dashboard opens with one, and the study setup summary becomes one on wide screens. Hierarchy comes from type size and weight and from rules (a 2px ink rule under each section title, hairlines between rows), not from boxes. Explanation and feedback arrive in titled blocks: a teal title strip over a pale teal-grey body, exactly as Metropolis draws them.

The density is that of a good handout: counts live in data tables and facts lists with right-aligned tabular figures, controls state their exact values, and the right column of a two-column frame holds the facts of the current session, the response to a graded answer, or the next action. Colour is disciplined. Teal does the structural work (title bar, band, primary buttons, block titles, heading rules); Metropolis orange marks only where the learner is (progress, the current item, the active route, reviews due); green and red appear only to report state. Three palettes (light, dark, contrast) share one set of token names, so every component follows the active theme without a reload; the default System preference picks light or dark from the browser and follows it live.

The world is flat. PRODUCT.md binds it to no skeuomorphism, and the shipped build carries no gradients, glow, icon tiles, or stacked shadowed cards; the only shadow in the system belongs to things that float (the theme menu, dialogs and toasts).
keyCharacteristics: A single dark teal title bar, sticky, 3.5rem tall, white Fira Sans on teal; where a page needs an overview, its ground carries on below it as a band with inverse buttons.
One orange rule: the progress line, the loading line, and the 3px underline under the active route or tab.
Titled blocks (teal strip, pale teal-grey body) for every explanation and piece of feedback.
Tables and facts lists with tabular figures right-aligned; no stat tiles.
Two radii only (2px and 4px); 1px borders; 2px ink rules under section titles.
Flat content on a tonal ground; shadows only on overlays.
Fira Sans for everything (Light only for figures and statements), Fira Mono for keys, model IDs, URLs and code; sentence-case copy.

rules.name: The Where-You-Are Rule
rules.body: Orange marks progress and the current item only: the current progress segment, the loading line, the active route and tab underline, review boxes with questions due, and "Active" or due labels. It never fills a button, a heading, a block, or a decorative surface.

rules.name: The Ink Twin Rule
rules.body: Every signal hue has an ink twin. The base (accent, success, error, warning) fills rules, strips and tints; text in that hue on the ground always uses the `*Ink` token. On a band the ground is Title-bar Teal, so due counts there use `--band-accent` (accent mixed 75% with Title-bar White) instead. Light-theme Metropolis Orange is 2.62:1 on the ground and never carries text.

rules.name: The Tint, Not Fill Rule
rules.body: State surfaces are tints mixed into the surface with `color-mix(in srgb, <hue> N%, var(--color-surface))`, never solid fills: choice checked (primary 8%), option selected (primary 9%), option correct (success 12%), option wrong (error 10%), success block body (success 10%), error block body (error 9%), error notice (error 10%), warning notice (warning 14%), accent tag (accent 16%), success tag (success 14%), error tag (error 12%), danger button hover (error 10%). The only solid state fills are block title strips, progress segments, and the scheduled and due review-box strips.

rules.name: The Size-and-Weight Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is size and weight (300 for figures and statements, then 400, 500, 600) plus rules. No text is uppercased or letter-spaced anywhere; tracking moves only on the page title, figures and statements (-0.01em) and the wordmark (0.01em). No kickers or eyebrows above titles.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Every count, score, percentage, ratio and date sets in tabular figures (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) and right-aligns in table number columns and facts values. Ratios are written with spaced slashes ("3 / 5", "0 / 1"); topic lists join with " · ".

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: All UI copy is sentence case: "Start review", "Recent sessions", "New study session", "End session".

rules.name: The One Measure Rule
rules.body: Reading text never runs wider than 68ch. Wide content (tables, two-column frames) may use the full 72rem; prose may not.

rules.name: The Overlays-Only Rule
rules.body: A shadow means "this floats above the page". Tables, blocks, bands, choice groups, option rows and every other piece of content sit flat on the ground; if it does not float, it does not cast.

rules.name: The Two Radii Rule
rules.body: 2px for what you read, 4px for what you press or type into; nothing rounder.

dos: Do put every route inside the 72rem frame under the teal title bar (the Dashboard band holds the same frame inside it), open with one `page-title` (the Dashboard's is visually hidden; its band opens the page), and head each section with a `section-title` and its 2px ink rule.
Do give each screen one primary (Deck Teal) button for the next step, or one inverse button on a band; make every other action secondary or ghost (outline inverse on a band).
Do carry a page's overview on a band: the title bar's ground below the bar, Title-bar White and Title-bar Mist for text and rules, inverse buttons for actions.
Do keep Metropolis Orange for progress and the current item, and set orange text in Burnt Orange Ink (`--band-accent` on a band).
Do set counts, scores, ratios and dates in tabular figures, right-aligned in tables and facts lists.
Do put explanations and feedback in titled blocks, and show grading as a tint mixed into the surface plus inked text.

Do style through the semantic tokens (`bg-shell`, `text-ink-soft`, `border-line-strong`) so all three themes follow; build tints with `color-mix()` in CSS, because the token classes take no `/opacity` modifier.
Do show any AI wait as the 4px loading rule with a one-line label.
Do raise transient, out-of-flow messages through the toast: a surface panel with a 4px state rule on top, a title and a short message.
Do write UI copy in sentence case.
donts: Don't use skeuomorphic texture, gradients or glow; PRODUCT.md rules out skeuomorphism.
Don't put a shadow on content; only menus, dialogs and toasts carry the overlay shadow.
Don't build stat tiles, icon tiles or stacked shadowed cards; numbers belong in data tables and facts lists.
Don't add a coloured side stripe to notices or blocks; state is a tint plus inked text.
Don't fill buttons, headings or surfaces with orange, or set text in the base accent.
Don't put primary, secondary or ghost buttons, or Deck Ink and Soft Slate text, on a band; they are drawn for the ground.
Don't uppercase or letter-space labels, or put kickers or eyebrows above titles.
Don't round anything past 4px or draw pills.
Don't hard-code hex in components; every colour comes from a `--color-*` token so the three themes stay whole.
